title: 5 funções do KizuBot que quase ninguém conhece
concept: A declassified-file countdown of five lesser-known KizuBot features (streamer mode, replying to PMs from Telegram, Offline Cam replays at up to 8x, KizuAI with sources, alarms on the smartwatch), each unredacted on the beat, with real customer prints for #4 and #1 and labelled illustrations for the rest.
hook: 5 FUNÇÕES QUE QUASE NINGUÉM CONHECE (DO KIZUBOT).
claims: alarmes no celular e notificações no WhatsApp
